text: A song of ascents: How happy is everyone who fears ADONAI, who lives by his ways.
You will eat what your hands have produced; you will be happy and prosperous.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine in the inner parts of your house. Your children around the table will be like shoots from an olive tree.
This is the kind of blessing that will fall on him who fears ADONAI.
May ADONAI bless you from Tziyon! May you see Yerushalayim prosper all the days of your life,
and may you live to see your children’s children! Shalom on Isra’el.
